    s.NCESDist,
    s.School,
    f.'Charter School (Y/N)' AS CharterStatus,
    s.StatusType AS CurrentOperationalStatus,
    s.OpenDate,
    frpm.ENROLK12 AS Enrollment,
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm.PERCENTELIGIBLEFREEK12 > 75.0 THEN 'High Poverty'
        WHEN frpm.PERCENTELIGIBLEFREEK12 > 50.0 THEN 'Medium Poverty'
        WHEN frpm.PERCENTELIGIBLEFREEK12 > 25.0 THEN 'Low Poverty'
        ELSE 'Very Low Poverty'
    END AS PovertyClassification,
    (SELECT AVG(AVGScrRead), AVG(AvgScrMath) FROM satscores WHERE s.cds = satscores.cds),
    COALESCE(
        ROUND((AVG(AVGScrRead) + AVG(AvgScrMath) + AVG(AvgScrWrite)) / 3, 2),
        NULL
    ) AS OverallAverageSATScore,
    ENRANK
FROM
    frpm
JOIN
    schools s ON frpm.CDSCode = s.CDSCode
WHERE
    (s.DOCType = 'State Special Schools' AND (frpm.ENROLK12 LIKE '3%' OR s.SOC LIKE '3%'))
GROUP BY
    s.NCESDist,
    s.School,
    f.'Charter School (Y/N)',
    s.StatusType,
    s.OpenDate,
    frpm.ENROLK12,
    CASE 
        WHEN frpm.PERCENTELIGIBLEFREEK12 > 75.0 THEN 'High Poverty'

        WHEN frpm.PERCENTELIGIBLEFREEK12 > 25.0 THEN 'Low Poverty'

    END,
    (SELECT AVG(AVGScrRead), AVG(AvgScrMath) FROM satscores WHERE s.cds = satscores.cds)
